tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rje rang byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i nges don phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam gyi 'grel chung

bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs so// ༄༅// bka' brgyud bla ma grub thob rgya mtsho'i chogs rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bstsal ba'i phyag chen smon lam gyi bsdus 'grel snying por dril ba las dpyad gsum smon lam gdab pa'i sbyor ba/ smon lam dngos/ smon lam gyi 'jug bsdu ba'o// dang po sbyor ba bstan pa'am dpang du gsol ba ni/ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi smon lam rnams// ji bzhin 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur byin brlabs mdzod// ces pa'i don/ na mo gu ru ni rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal ba'o// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha tshogs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la brtse bar dgongs te bdag smon lam rnam par dag pa ji bzhin du 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur mdzad du gsol/ zhes so// smon lam dngos la spyi dang bye brag gnyis te/ dang po ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// bsam sbyor rnam dag gangs ri las skyes pa'i// 'khor gsum rnyog med dge tshogs chu rgyun rnams// rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig / ces pa snyan ngag gzugs can gyi rgyan du bkod pa ste/ bsam sbyor rnam dag ces pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa ni/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta la sogs pa'i yid kyi kun slong mi dge ba rnams ma yin par byams pa dang snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems sogs kun slong dge ba'am/ sbyor ba rnam par dag pa ni/ lus ngag gi legs par sbyang ba rnams te/ de yang kun slong dge bas bskyod pa 'ba' zhig dgos so// 'khor gsum rnyog med ni/ smon par bya ba'i yul/

smon pa dngos/ smon lam 'debs pa po gsum mi dmigs pa dgongs te/ dmigs bcas ni chu rnyog pa bzhin no// 'di'i 'khor gsum dmigs bral gyi shes rab dngos ni 'phags pa rnams las gzhan la med cing*/ lung dang bla ma'i gdams ngag gis rjes mthun rtogs pa ni so skye la'ang yod do// 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos rnams mdor bsdus pa'i smon lam ste tshig rjes ma rnams kyang 'di nyid las 'phros par shes dgos so// gnyis pa bye brag phye ste smon lam gdab pa la lnga/ lam gyi rten phun sum tshogs pa la smon pa/ lam rtogs byed kyi shes rab la smon pa/ 'khrul med kyi lam nyid la smon pa/ lam de nyams su len tshul ma 'khrul ba la smon pa/ de mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu la smon pa'o// dang po la'ang thun mong dang thun min gnyis/ dang po ni/ ji srid de ma thob pa de srid du// skye dang skye ba tshe rabs kun tu yang*// sdig dang sdug bsngal sgra yang mi grags shing*// bde dge'i rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par shog / ces pa ste/ tshig rkang snga ma gnyis kyi ni skye ba 'di nas bzung sngar bshad pa'i rgyal ba sku bzhi'i go 'phang khyad par can de ma thob kyi bar tshe rabs thams cad ces bstan cing*/ phyi ma gnyis kyis der rgyu sdig pa dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi sgra yang mi grag par rgyu dge ba dang 'bras bu bde ba rgya mtsho lta bu'i dpal la spyod pa kho nar gyur cig ces bstan to// gnyis pa ni/ dal 'byor mchog thob dad brtson shes rab ldan// bshes gnyen bzang bsten gdams pa'i bcud thob nas// tshul bzhin bsgrub la bar chad ma mchis par// tshe rabs kun tu dam chos spyod par shog / ces pa la gong gi ji srid de ma thob pa de srid du zhes pa dang 'brel te tshe rabs thams cad du dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob cing*/ dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ shes rab gsum dang ldan pas lam gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po bsten cing gdams ngag zab mo'i bcud thob nas de'i don tshul bzhin du sgrub cing nyams su len pa la bar chad med cing skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad rnam dkar dam pa'i lha chos la spyod par shog ces pa'o//

gnyis pa lam rtogs byed kyi shes rab la smon pa ni/ lung rigs thos pas mi shes sgrib las grol// man ngag bsam pas the tshom mun nag bcom// sgom byung 'od kyis gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal// shes rab gsum gyi snang ba rgyas par shog / ces pa ste/ tshig rkang dang pos thos pa'i shes rab/ gnyis pas bsam pa'i shes rab/ gsum pas sgom pa'i shes rab/ bzhi pas de gsum gyi don bsdus pa'o// gsum pa 'khrul med kyi lam nyid la smon pa ni/ rtag chad mtha' bral bden gnyis gzhi yi don// sgro skur mtha' bral tshogs gnyis lam mchog gis// srid zhi'i mtha' bral don gnyis 'bras thob pa'i// gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang phrad par shog / ces pa ste/ de'ang tshig rkang dang pos shes bya gzhi'i gnas lugs ma 'khrul bar bstan/ gnyis pas sgrub byed lam gyi nyams len ma 'khrul bar bstan/ gsum pas bsgrub bya 'bras bu'i gnas skabs ma 'khrul bar bstan/ bzhi pas 'khrul med gsum dang ldan pa'i chos de gol 'chug med pa'i lam yang dag yin par gdams nas de lta bu la smon par mdzad pa'o// bzhi pa lam de nyams su len tshul ma 'khrul ba la smon pa la gnyis/ go don mdor bstan pa dang sgom don lag tu len pa'o// dang po ni/ sbyang gzhi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug la// sbyong byed phyag chen rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ches// sbyang bya glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma rnams// sbyangs 'bras dri bral chos sku mngon gyur shog / ces pa ste/ lam dus kyi phyag rgya chen po nyams su len tshul la/ go bar bya ba'i gdan dam pa gang du sbyang ba'i gzhi/ gang gis sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor/ gang zhig sbyang ba'i dri ma/ sbyangs pa thob pa'i 'bras bu ste rnam pa bzhi yin pas de dag rim bzhin rkang pa so sos bstan cing mthar smon pa'i tshig sbyar ba'o// gzhi lam 'bras gsum du don dril te bstan pa ni/ rje bzhad pa rdo rjes/

gzhi ma bcos khyab dal chen po shar// lam ma bcos zang thal chen po shar// 'bras bu ma bcos phyag rgya chen po shar// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa sgom don lag tu len pa la mdor bstan pa dang rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa lta ba'i gdengs// de la ma yengs skyong ba sgom pa'i gnad// sgom don kun la rtsal sbyong spyod pa'i mchog /lta sgom spyod pa'i gdengs dang ldan par shog / ces pa gzhi lta bas gtan la phab nas lam ma yengs par sgom pas tshul bzhin du nyams su len cing*/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi sgom don kun la rtsal sbyong ba ni spyod pas bogs 'don pa'i mchog ste de gsum gyi gdengs dang ldan par shog ces pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ lta bas gzhi la sgro 'dogs gcod tshul/ de sgom pas gtan la 'bebs tshul/ de spyod pas mthar dbyung tshul/ lam mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu la smon pa'o// dang po la'ang mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul ste// sems ni sems med sems kyi ngo bos stong*// stong zhing ma 'gags cir yang snang ba ste// legs par brtag nas gzhi rtsa chod par shog / ces pa ste/ rkang pa dang pos snang ba thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul du thag bcad/ gnyis pas sems rang bzhin med par gtan la phab/ gsum pas stong dang rten 'byung zung du 'jug pa mi 'gal bar bstan/ bzhi pas de ltar so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis brtags pas gzhi'i don la sgro 'dogs thams cad gcod dgos par smon pa'i tshul gyi gdams pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la bzhi/ gong gi mdor bstan de nyid rkang pa dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa rnams so sor 'chad pa'o// dang po snang ba thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul du thag bcad pa ni/ yod ma myong ba'i rang snang yul du 'khrul// ma rig dbang gis rang rig bdag tu 'khrul// gnyis 'dzin dbang gis srid pa'i klong du 'khyams// ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad dar chod par shog

/ ces pas ston te/ 'dir dngos bstan rags pa kun rdzob kyi snang tshul dang*/ shugs bstan phra ba don dam gyi chos nyid dbyer med rtogs dgos pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa sems rang bzhin med par gtan la 'bebs pa la gnyis/ yod med kyi mtha' spangs pa dang*/ yin min gyi mtha' spangs pa'o// dang po ni/ yod pa ma yin rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs// med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// 'gal 'du ma yin zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam// mtha' bral sems kyi chos nyid rtogs par shog / ces pa ste/ kun rdzob kyi snang tshul 'di dag tshugs thub tu grub pa'i bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med de/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pas ma gzigs pa'i phyir/ don dam par med pa'ang ma yin te stong dang rten 'brel 'gal med du 'char bas 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'phro gzhir gyur pa de gnyis rtag dngos gnyis lta bu 'gal 'du ma yin te/ snang stong zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam yang dag pa yin pa'i phyir spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i sems kyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs par shog ces pa ste/ rje btsun chen pos/ yod par dngos por snang ba dang*// med pa stong pa'i chos nyid gnyis// ngo bo dbyer med ro gcig pas// rang rig gzhan rig yod min te// thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ 'di yin zhes pa gang gis mtshon pa med// 'di min zhes bya gang gis bkag pa med// blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas// yang dag don gyi mtha' ni nges par shog / ces pa ste/ 'di yin zhes 'dus byas dngos po'i chos gang gis kyang mtshon pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ 'di min no zhes gang gis kyang bkag pa med de/ blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min// bla ni kun rdzob yin pas// zhes gsungs pa ltar yang dag pa'i don mthar phyin te nges par shog ces pa'o//

gsum pa stong dang rten 'byung zung du 'jug pa mi 'gal bar ston pa ni/ 'di nyid ma rtogs 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor// 'di nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas gzhan na med// thams cad 'di yin 'di min gang yang med// chos nyid kun gzhi'i mtshang ni rig par shog / ces pa ste/ gong du bshad pa ltar gnas lugs sems kyi gsang 'di nyid ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khor ba'i lugs 'byung gi rten 'brel 'byung la/ 'di nyid rtogs na lugs ldog gi rten 'brel las sangs rgyas pa yin zhing sangs rgyas de'ang gnas lugs kyi don 'di las logs su yod pa ma yin no// de'ang sems kyi gshis skye ba med pa chos sku/ gdangs 'gags pa med pa longs sku/ rtsal snang sna tshogs su 'char ba sprul pa'i sku ste 'di nyid ma rtogs 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor 'khor nas/ sems 'di nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas gzhan du yod pa ma yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de nyid gsal ba sangs rgyas te// zhes dang*/ 'da' dka' ye shes las/ sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes so// 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad sems nyid 'di'i rol rtsal las gzhan gang yang yod pa min la/ chos nyid dag pa'i kun gzhi dang ma dag pa'i kun gzhi gnad dang mtshang rig nas grol bar shog cig ces pa'o// bzhi pa de ltar so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis brtags pas gzhi la sgro 'dogs bcad dgos par gdams pa/ snang yang sems la stong yang sems yin te// rtogs kyang sems la 'khrul yang rang gi sems// skyes kyang sems la 'gags kyang sems yin pas// sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par shog / rnam shes tshogs drug gi yul du snang yang sems yin la ma rtogs 'khrul na'ang rang gi sems snang las gzhan du med cing*/

rnam rtog 'khrul pa sna tshogs skye/ sems la de dag 'gags kyang sems nyid gcig pu yin pas lta bas gtan la 'bebs pa'i sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par shog /ces pa ste/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjes/ phyi snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*/ ma rtogs dus na 'khrul snang ste// yul gyi zhen pas 'ching bar zad// rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang sems kyi grogs su 'char// mthar thug don la snang ma myong*// skye med chos skur dag go gsungs/ zhes so// gnyis pa sgom pas gtan la 'bebs tshul la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po/ blos byas rtsol ba'i sgom gyis ma bslad cing*// tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod par// ma bcos gnyug ma rang bab 'jog shes pa'i// sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong bar shog / ces pa ste/ rnam par rtog pa'i blos byas pa'i sgom gyi sems nyid chos kyi sku ma bslad cing sems tha mal gyi zang zing 'khrul ba'i 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog rlung gis mi bskyod par/ gnas dben par sems nyid ma bcos gnyug ma rang bab tu 'jog shes pa ni pha dam pas/ sems ma bcos na bde// chu ma rnyogs na dwangs// ces gsungs pa ltar sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong ba la le lo med pa'i brtson 'grus chu bo'i rgyun ltar du shog ces pa'o// ji skud du'ang*/ blo ngan goms bag chags shog dril 'dra// sgom yun thung gis rnam rtog mi khegs kyis// sgom yun bsrings dang rtogs ldan rnams// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor/ de las nyams rtogs skye tshul/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi nyams len no// dang po la'ang gsum/ zhi gnas/ lhag mthong*/ zhi lhag zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor de'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs so// dang po ni/ phra rags rtogs pa'i dba' rlabs rang sar zhi// g.yo med sems kyi chu bo ngang gis gnas// bying rmugs rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i// zhi gnas rgya mtsho mi g.yo brtan par shog

/ ces pa ste/ dbang po'i rim pas dmigs bcas dmigs med mnyam bzhag rim gyis nyams su len pa'am thog ma nas dmigs med la 'jug pa gang rung gi sgo nas thog mar zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ba yin no// de'ang zhi gnas kyi sgra don ni sems nyon mongs pa'i rnam par rtog pa zhi zhing dge ba'i ngo bor rtse gcig tu gnas pa la bya'o// rnam rtog phra rags kyi rba rlabs rnams sems nyid ma bcos rnal ma'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas rang sar zhi nas sems nyid g.yo med kyi chu bo rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil ba ltar ngang gis gnas pa zhig dgos te/ phyag chen gang gā ma las/ sems la gtad so med de phyag chen yin// 'di la goms shing 'dris na byang chub dam pa thob// las ni dang po gcong rong chu dang 'dra// bar du chu bo gang gar dal gyis 'bab// tha ma chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa bzhin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zhi ma gnas na lhag mi mthong ba'i dpe ltar zhi gnas skyon med la 'bad pa gal che'o// sems mi gsal zhing 'thib pa'i bying ba dang rnam rtog mang du 'phro ba'i rgod pa dang ches mi gsal zhing nag thom me ba 'dra bas rmugs pa dang*/ chu rnyog pa ltar sems rnam rtog gi rtog pas bslad de sa ler mi gsal ba'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i zhi gnas kyi rgya mtsho chen po la rnam rtog rlung gi rba rlabs kyis mi g.yo zhing rab tu brtan par shog ces pa'o// ji skad du'ang*/ bzhag na g.yo med ri yi rgyal po ltar// btang na dge ba'i dngos po kun la 'jug /lus sems las su rung ba'i shin sbyangs nyid// thob pa de ni zhi gnas yang dag go /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//

gnyis pa lhag mthong la gnyis/ dngos dang gzhi rtsa gcod pa'o// dang po ni/ bltar med sems la yang yang bltas pa'i tshe// mthong med don ni ji bzhin lhag ger mthong*// yin min don la the tshom chod pa nyid// 'khrul med rang ngo rang gis shes par shog / ces pa ste/ blta ba'i yul las 'das pas blta bar byar med pa'i sems dngos po'i gnas lugs de nyid la mnyam par bzhag cing bla ma'i man ngag dang bsgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi mig gis yang dang yang du bltas pa de'i tshe/ mthong ba dang bral ba'i don ji lta ba bzhin lhag ger mthong bas/ gnas lugs kyi don de la yin min yod med la sogs pa'i sgro 'dogs dang the tshom thams cad de nyid du chod de 'khrul ba med pa'i rang ngo rang gis shes pa'i tshul du gsal bar myong ba de lta bu'i lhag mthong gi ye shes skyes nas lhan skyes phyag rgya chen po ste mngon du 'gyur bar shog ces pa'o// rje btsun chen pos/ rnal 'byor mi la ras pa ngas/ cer gyis bltas pas ngo bo mthong*// spros bral nam mkha'i dkyil ltar mthong*// cog ge bzhag pas gnas lugs rtogs// dngos kun stong pa'i ngo bor rtogs// lhod kyi lod pas rang sa zin// rig pa'i ngo bor dwangs snyigs byed// lings kyis bor bas dran rtog chad// 'gro drug g.yang sa rbad kyis chod// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa gzhi rtsa gcod pa ni/ yul la bltas pas yul med sems su mthong*// sems la bltas pas sems med ngo bos stong*// gnyis la bltas pas gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol// 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog / ces pa'o// de'ang yul ni gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos rnams te/ gang shar zhes gang shar gyi snang ba de dag gi steng du bltas nas mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom byung gi shes rab gnas yul rnams rang ngo ma grub pa sems tsam du mthong bar 'gyur zhing de bzhin du sems kyi rang ngo la bltas nas mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthus sems kyang gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs par 'gyur ba dang*/

snang sems gnyis ka ro mnyam du mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthus yul yul can gyi gnyis su 'dzin pa gzhi med du rang sar grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir thabs de lta bu la brten nas rang bzhin gyis sgrib pa dang bral bas 'od gsal ba'i sems kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i lhag dbulamathong gi ye shes skye bar shog /ces pa ste/ zhang rin po ches/ shes pa lhod kyis glod pa'i tshe// gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams// bar snga phug pa'i dkyil ltar 'char// de ni 'od gsal chos sku yin// zhes so// gsum pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ yid byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che// mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma chen po yin// 'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya// gcig shes kun don rtogs pa'i gdengs thob shog / ces pa ste/ de'ang rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa ji lta bar rtogs pa de yid la byed pa thams cad dang bral bas phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba yin la/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs gzhan yang mtha' thams cad dang bral bas dbu ma chen po zhes dang*/ chos thams cad kyi don dang rtogs pa 'dir 'dus pas rdzogs pa chen po zhes kyang bya ste/ de bzhin nyid gcig pu 'di kho na shes pas chos thams cad kyi gnad gsang ma lus pa rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pa zhig dgos so// zhes gdams pa'i phyir smon pa'o/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pas/ rnam rtog dang ni nyon mongs pa// thams cad 'dul bas 'dul ba yin// rnam par rtog pa chos sku ru// nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa'i sa// sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pas na// 'di ni bla ma'i gdams ngag yin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i phyir// sems su rdzogs pas rdzogs chen yin// bzang rtog ngan rtog thams cad kun// yid la mi byed phyag rgya che// sdug bsngal zhi bas zhi byed yin/ nyon mongs dang ni rnam rtog kun// lam du slong bas gsang sngags yin// sems dang rnam rtog chos sku gsum// dang po lhan cig skyes pa ste// gdams pas gcig tu sbyor ba'i phyir// lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes su bshad// 'dre dang bdud la sogs pa yi// bar gcod la yang bsngags so gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//

gnyis pa de la nyams rtogs skyes tshul la gnyis/ nyams dang rtogs pa'o// dang po ni/ zhen pa med pa'i bde chen rgyun chad med// mtshan 'dzin med pa'i 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs bral// blo las 'das pa'i mi rtogs lhun gyis grub// rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog / ces pa ste/ de ltar zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor la mnyam par bzhag pa na skyon med pa'i nyams gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ zhen chags dang bral ba'i bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams dang yul la mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i rang rig 'od gsal sgrib g.yog dang bral ba'i nyams dang blo'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i mi rtog stong pa nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i nyams so// de ltar bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum ka'ang 'byung du re ba dang ma byung gis dogs pa sogs gang gis kyang mi bslad par gnyug ma'i ngang du bzlas kyang rtsol sgrub med par ngang gis rgyun mi chad du 'byung ba chos nyid do// de la nyams skyon dang bcas pa ni chags zhen dang bcas pa'i bde nyams/ mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i 'od gsal/ blos bzung ba'i mi rtog rnams te/ 'di dag dang pos 'dod khams su gol/ gnyis pas gzugs khams su gol/ gsum pas gzugs med khams su gol ba'i phyir chags zhen la sogs pa'i skyon de dag ni rnam pa kun tu spangs par bya zhing khyad par nyams ma skyes pa la skye ba'i phyir rtsol bar byed pa dang*/ skyes pa la ched du 'dzin pa gnyis ka'ang skyon yin par mtshungs te snga mas nyams myong skye ba'i gegs byed cing phyi mas skyes pa rgyun chad par 'gyur ba'i phyir rnam pa kun tu re dwogs mtshan 'dzin rtsol sgrub rnams kyi rtog pa spang ba nyid gnad che'o// zhes gdams pa'i phyir smon lam mdzad pa'o// ji skad du'ang*/ bde gsal mi rtog rnam gsum la// zhen na khams gsum 'khor bar 'khor// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/

bzang zhen nyams kyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol// ngan rtogs 'khrul pa rang bzhin dbyings su dag /tha mal shes pa spang blang bral thob med// spros bral chos nyid bden pa rtogs par shog /ces pas bstan te/ bshad ma thag pa ltar nyams skyes pa la bzang rlom gyi shes pa rang sar grol zhing*/ 'khrul chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rtog pa ni/ gnas lugs kyi don mthong ba la sgrib par byed pas ngan par 'jog pa'i phyir rtog pa ngan pa yin la de'i ched du ma spangs kyang mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthus rang bzhin gyis de kho na nyid kyi dbyings su dag pas tha mal gyi shes pa gnyug ma'i sems de nyid mngon du gyur pa na spang bya sgrib pa'i chos gang yang spangs pa med pa'i tshul khong du chud pa dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te blang bya gnyen po'i chos dang*/ spang bya spangs pa las byung ba'i bral ba dang spang bya byas pas thob pa'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa ste de'i rang bzhin du med cing mi gnas pa'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin khong du chud dbulapas/ skye 'gag rtag chad 'gro 'ong gcig tha dad sogs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos nyid kyi bde ba rtogs pa yin no// zhes stong pa'i phyir de la smon par mdzad pa'o// ji skad du 'ang*/ rnam rtog spros pa bral nas su// ngo bo lhag ger mthong ba la// chos nyid bden pa rtogs pa ste// rab dga'i sa la gnas par nges// zhes pa'o// gsum pa stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi nyams len la gnyis/ snying rje ngos bzung ba dang*/ de stong pa nyid la zung du 'jag tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu sangs rgyas kyang*// ma rtogs dbang gis mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i sems can la// bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog /ces pas bstan te/ de'ang spyir snying rje la sems can dang chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang gsum du gsungs pa dang po gnyis ni khrid srol 'di'i sngon 'gro'i skabs su nyams su len bya yin la/

gnas lugs kyi don mthong nas dmigs med kyi snying rje skye zhing*/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ zhes bya ba de 'byung ba yin pas/ 'dir bstan gyi snying rje'ang phyi ma yin no// 'o na de'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ gong du lta ba'i don 'chad pa'i skabs la bshad pa ltar/ 'gro ba 'di rnams kyi rang bzhin ni dus rtag tu sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i ngo bor bzhugs pa yin kyang*/ de ltar du ma rtogs pa kho na'i dbang gis mtha' med pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams nas sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho mu med pa'i nang du bying bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje drag po rgyun mi chad par rtsol med du skyes pa yin zhing*/ de yang gnas lugs kyi don mthong ba'i dbang gis 'byung ste/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' mnyam gzhag pas// goms pa'i stobs ni rdzogs pa na// dngos 'dzin gdon gyis zin pa la// khyad par du yang snying rje skye// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la skye bar shog ces pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bzod med snying rje'i rtsal yang ma 'gags pa'i// brtse dus ngo bo stong don rjen par shar// zung 'jug gol sa bral ba'i lam mchog 'di// 'bral med nyin mtshan kun tu bsgom par shog / ces pa ste/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i rtsal de'ang ma 'gags par 'char bzhin pa nas/ brtse ba'i dus de tsam nyid na spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi don yang 'ol spyi tsam ma yin par mngon sum rjen par shar bas stong pa nyid dang snying rje ro mnyam du 'dres pa'i zung 'jug gi lam de ni gol sa dang bral ba'i lam gyi mchog yin no// de lta bu'i don 'gal med nyin mtshan kun tu sgom par shog ces pa'o// gsum pa spyod pas lam mthar dbyung tshul ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa nyid las/

spyod pa gzhan du med pa'i phyir gong du shugs kyis bstan pa yin te/ spros med nang gi spyod pa'am kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa nyid ni dran dang shes bzhin bag yod gsum la gnas pa'o// bzhi pa lam mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu la smon pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad lnga pa lam de mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu la smon pa phyogs gcig tu bstan pa ni/ sgom stobs las byung spyan dang mngon shes dang*// sems can smin byas sangs rgyas zhing rab sbyangs// sangs rgyas chos rnams 'grub pa'i smon lam rdzogs// rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog / ces pa ste/ 'di la gnyis/ dngos dang zhar byung lam gyi rim pa cung zad bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ spyan dang mngon shes bshad pa dang*/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar gdams ngag phyin ci ma log par nyams su blangs pas sgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa ni chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ de'ang spyan dang mngon shes sogs shin tu yongs su dag pa'i yon tan ldan zhing rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin pa yin pa dang*/ lam dus su thog mar mngon shes sogs bskyed nas rim gyis rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar dbyung dgos pas na/ 'bras bu ni thog mar spyan dang mngon shes nyid 'jog ste/ spyan lnga ni/ stong gsum gyi gzugs phra rags thams cad mthong ba sha'i spyan/ sems can gyi skye ba dang 'chi ba shes pa lha'i spyan/ chos thams cad bdag med par rtogs pa shes rab kyi spyan no// 'phags pa dag gi dbang po rno rtul dang gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi tshig don rnams thogs med du shes pa chos kyi spyan no// ji lta ji snyed kyi chos mtha' dag rtogs pa sangs rgyas kyi spyan no// mngon shes drug ni/ gcig las du ma dang du ma las mang por bsgyur ba sogs rdzu 'phrul du ma la dbang ba rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/

sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ stong gsum gyi sgra che chung thams cad shes pa lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes/ rang dang gzhan gyi skye ba sngon ma sogs du ma shes pa sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes/ sems can gzhan gyi sems kyi bsam pa thams cad shes pa gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi las nyon zad par shes pa zag zad kyi mngon shes dang drug go /spyan dang mngon shes gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ spyan ni las dge ba'i rnam smin las byung ba yin la/ mngon shes ni bsam gtan grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis thob pa yin no// gnyis pa rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum bshad pa ni/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis lhag pa'i bsam pa dang smon lam spyod pa rgya chen po la gnas nas spyan dang*/ mngon par shes la sogs pa'i mthu chen po dang*/ thabs dpag tu med pa sems can mtha' dag smin par mdzad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs pa'i smon lam mthar phyin par mdzad nas mngon par rdzogs pa yin no// zhing sbyong ba ni/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las/ de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ rgyal ba rnams kyis zhing gi bkod la 'jug /ces dang*/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te// zhes dang*/ zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro// sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'i smon lam rdzogs pa ni/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas gsungs pa'i smon lam grangs med pa khrag khrig brgya stong gi 'khor dang bcas pa yongs su grub pa na sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par yin no// sangs rgyas kyi sgra don ni budha zhes pa'i sgra sangs pa'am rgyas pa la 'jug pas/ ji skad du/ ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang*// shes bya la yang blo rgyas phyir// sangs rgyas padma ltar sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams sbyang smin mthar phyin nas gdod nas smon lam thams cad rdzogs te sangs rgyas pa yin la/

sngags su mi tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang nyid mngon du byed pa'i tshe na'ang thabs mkhas pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyi stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pas rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum myur du mthar phyin par go dgos// gnyis pa zhar byung lam gyi rim pa cung zad smos pa ni/ grub chen nā ro pas/ phyag rgya chen po tshigs bsdus su gsungs pa ltar brgyud pa 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skad du mdzad pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa nyid kyi 'chad na/ dang po zhi gnas kyi sems rtse gcig pa thob nas gnas pa la lhag mthong shar zhing*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'khor yug tu 'byung ba'i skabs rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor zhes bya/ gnyis pa snang sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos mtha' dag chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las ma 'das par mthong bas gnyis chos kyi spros 'dzin thams cad rang grol du song*/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ye shes lhag mthong mtshan nyid pa thob pas zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor ji lta ba zung du chud pa spros bral/ gsum pa de gong nas gong du sgom pas chos thams cad ro gcig tu rtogs shing rtsol med kyi ye shes nub pa med pa ro gcig /bzhi pa bsgom pa'i 'od gsal dang gzhi'i 'od gsal gcig tu 'dres pas gnas lugs kyi sgrib g.yogs mtha' dag gzhi med du dwangs/ mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams zhig mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad lhun grub tu byung ba sgom med kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o// de dag la'ang so sor chung 'bring chen por phye bas bcu gnyis su 'gyur la/ so so'i rnam dbye zhib mo dang yon tan skye tshul sogs rgyas pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros las 'byung ba ltar shes par byos shig /de dag phar phyin theg pa'i sa lam dang sbyar na rtse gcig gsum tshogs lam/ spros bral chung 'bring sbyor lam/ spros bral chen po mthong la ma/
ro gcig nas sgom med 'bring po'i bar sgom lam/ sgom med chen po sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhed cing don la'ang gnas pa'o//

rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa smon lam gyi mjug bsdu ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang*// rnam dkar dge ba ji snyed yod pa'i mthus// de ltar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// smon lam rnam dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig / ces pa gzhan ni go sla la/ dge ba ji snyed yod pa zhes pa'i sgra 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge ba gnyis ka bsdus pa yin cing*/ 'ga' zhig gis 'dus ma byas chos kyi dbyings dge bar mi 'dod pa yod mod kyi rang lugs 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo rnams su kun gzhi'i ngang lugs dge ba ni/ zhes sogs gsal bar lam mang du gsungs pa ltar 'dus byas dge sdig gi zlas phye ba'i dge ba min kyang rnam byang dge ba'i chos mtha' dag gi go 'byed pa'i nus pa yod pa'i cha nas dge bar 'jog pa yin no// smon lam rnam dag ces pas 'dir bstan gyi smon lam nyid gtsor byas nas/ mtha' yas pa'i skye 'phags kyi smon lam rnam par dag pa ji snyed pa bsdus pa yin no// phyag rgya chen po smon lam gyi rnam grangs dang brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams shes par 'dod na/ si tu kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed kyi zhal nas mdzad pa'i 'grel chen grub pa mchog gi zhal lung las shes par bya'o// smras pa/ kun mkhyen zhal lung zab pa'i ma ma las// rang blos bsdus pa'i bum bzang chu rgyun gyi// blo ldan thos bsam sgom par 'jug 'dod rnams// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi smin grol shog /ces nges don phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam la 'grel ba kha gsal go bde zhig 'bri dgos zhes kun mkhyen bo dong pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i bla sprul rtogs ldan rnams kyis ring mo nas bskul ba dang*/ nye char zur mang lha lung bde gsal mchog sprul kyis bka' nan spyi bor phebs pa'i zhal ngo ldog ma phod par mkhan ming karma ratnas si tu'i 'grel chen las bsdus te bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni rang slob bhikshu karma shes rab rang grol gyis bgyis pa lung rtogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyal la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /sarba maṅga lam bi dza yantu//
